transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we proceed with anything else, I want to flag that we have a trial participant scheduled for an investigational infusion tomorrow at the hospital research unit. I understand the research unit has not yet authorized the dose or finalized the participant's monitoring and discharge arrangements. As the Clinical Research Medical Director, I'm prepared to sign off on the infusion authorization and the accompanying care plan today. However, I want to make sure we go through our standard pre-dose huddle first -- with research pharmacy, laboratory coordination, compliance, and social work reporting their operational findings -- so that I have all the information I need before authorizing. Can we get that huddle scheduled for today?
